svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Stack. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C, x86-64 Assembly. Systems: Clang, LLD, NASM, QEMU, Git, Docker. Web: React, Next.js, Tailwind, Framer Motion, GSAP, Three.js, CesiumJS. Ai / Vision: PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-image, LLM APIs, Ollama. Design: Figma, Design Systems, Motion Design. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
